## Ingredients
- chicken (raw; grillable from raw)
- bun bot (ready to use)
- bun top (ready to use)

## Available Actions
- **grill** `<item>`  —  Grill an item on the grill. Takes 10 seconds. Produces a grilled item.
- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

## Station Constraints
- **grill**: capacity 1 (at most 1 grill action running at once)

## Goal
The following ingredients must be prepared:
- chicken must be grilled

Assemble the final dish by stacking the ingredients in this order (bottom to top):
  1. bun bot
  2. grilled chicken
  3. bun top
domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates (raw ?i - item) (grilled ?i - item) (stackable ?i - item) (stacked ?i - item) (ready ?i - item) (grill_free))

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (grill_free)) ))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))

  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken)) (at start (grilled chicken)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken))) (at end (stacked chicken))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked chicken)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
)
problem_pddl:
(define (problem grill_chicken_burger)
  (:domain cooking)
  (:objects chicken bun_bot bun_top - item)
  (:init
    (raw chicken)
    (stackable bun_bot) (ready bun_bot)
    (stackable bun_top) (ready bun_top)
    (grill_free)
  )
  (:goal (and (grilled chicken) (stacked bun_bot) (stacked chicken) (stacked bun_top)))
)

    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)

    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and

              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))

              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))

  )

              (at end (stackable tempeh03))
              (at end (marinator_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    patty09 steak09 fish09 potato09 yam09 lettuce09 cucumber09 stock09 bun_bot bun_top - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

  ;; Cut action (generic for items cuttable from raw)
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (cut ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Boil (generic for items boilable from raw)
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (boiler_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (boiled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (boiler_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Generic grill is not used because items have different grill input requirements;
  ;; item-specific grill actions are provided below.

  ;; Fry for fish09 from raw -> fried
  (:durative-action fry_fish09
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw fish09)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw fish09)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (fried fish09))
      (at end (stackable fish09))
      (at end (fryer_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Fry for potato09 from cut -> fried (must be cut first)
  (:durative-action fry_potato09
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut potato09)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut potato09)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (fried potato09))
      (at end (stackable potato09))
      (at end (fryer_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Marinate for steak09: requires cut -> marinated
  (:durative-action marinate_steak09
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut steak09)) (at start (marinator_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut steak09)))
      (at start (not (marinator_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (marinated steak09))
      (at end (stackable steak09))
      (at end (marinator_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled yam09)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (boiled yam09)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (mashed yam09))
      (at end (stackable yam09))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw patty09)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))

      (at start (not (grill_free)))

    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable steak09)) (at start (grilled steak09)) (at start (stacked lettuce09)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable steak09))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked steak09)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

    :condition (and (at start (stackable cucumber09)) (at start (cut cucumber09)) (at start (stacked steak09)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable cucumber09))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked cucumber09)) (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (ready bun_top)) (at start (stacked cucumber09)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    salmon18 mushroom18 falafel18 onion18 turnip18 tomato18 pepper18 broth18 bun_bot bun_top - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

  ;; Generic grill: raw -> grilled (for items grillable from raw)
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (grilled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (grill_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Specific grill for items that require marinated input (mushroom18)
  (:durative-action grill_mushroom18
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated mushroom18)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (marinated mushroom18)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (grilled mushroom18))
      (at end (stackable mushroom18))
      (at end (grill_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (cut ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Generic fry: raw -> fried
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (fried ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (fryer_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Specific fry for onion18 which must be cut before frying
  (:durative-action fry_onion18
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut onion18)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut onion18)))
      (at start (not (fryer_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (fried onion18))
      (at end (stackable onion18))
      (at end (fryer_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (boiler_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (boiled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (boiler_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (cut ?i)))
      (at start (not (marinator_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (marinated ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (marinator_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
      (at end (mashed ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (robot_free ?r))
    )
  )

  ;; Stack actions in required order. Each is robot-parameterized and requires robot_free.
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot

    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)) (at start (ready bun_bot)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)) (at end (robot_free ?r)))

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable pepper18))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked pepper18)) (at end (robot_free ?r)))

(define (domain cooking)

    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))

              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))

- **stack** `<item>`  —  Place an ingredient on top of the current stack. Takes 1 second. The item must already be in its required state before stacking.

- **cutting board**: capacity 1 (at most 1 cut/mash action running at once)
- **fryer**: capacity 1 (at most 1 fry action running at once)
- **boiler**: capacity 1 (at most 1 boil action running at once)

      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at end (mashed turnip10))
      (at end (stackable turnip10))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))
      (at end (done_mash_turnip10))))

    (done_grill_salmon14)

              (at end (boiled ?i))

              (at end (boiler_free))))
